values.note: recreation.gov: 'Woodcock Lake Park Campground is currently closed to camping' and 'There are currently no camping opportunities at Woodcock Lake Park.' No reopening date is announced; the facility is marked not reservable.

status.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10132301 (notice 'Woodcock Lake Park Campground is currently closed to camping'; Overview 'There are currently no camping opportunities at Woodcock Lake Park'; rule reservationCutOff 'Not Reservable'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Recorded the closure as a status (temporarily closed, no reopening announced) from recreation.gov's own notice. Everything else left as recorded: the $18 standard non-electric rate still sits in the rate table through 2028, but nothing is bookable, and no page describes the sites now.
flags: Closure may be permanent: recreation.gov says only 'currently closed to camping' / 'no camping opportunities' with no reopening date, and The Dyrt (aggregator) reported the campground closed as of August 2024. A human should decide whether the entry stays as temporarily closed or leaves the database. The USACE Pittsburgh District page refused plain HTTP; the facility phone is 814-763-4422.

Unverified lead: an aggregator (Outdoorithm) describes the former camping as 'primitive walk-in' on Friday-Sunday nights; if the sites were walk-in only, the entry would also fail the drive-in criterion when it reopens.
